title: Emikono Egikolimiddwa
intro: Oyimiridde mu makubo agayiringisibwa mu Makkah ey’edda, emmeeme ey’obuyinza n’obugagga gye yava edda okuva ku mulanga gw’amazima. Emboozi ya ffiga eno ejjukiza nnyo nti ensiba z’omusaayi teziyinza kuvvuunuka njegere z’amalala. Ono ani erinnya lye eriwuuma n’omuliro ogulindiridde?
clues: Natambula mu nguudo z’e Makkah n’amalala aganziba amaaso nga simanyi mazima, wadde ng’omubaka yali wa musaayi gwange.
Ebintu byange byali binene nnyo, naye byafuuka ekikolimo okusinga engabo.
Ekitabo eky’obulagirizi kyogera ku kuzikirizibwa kwange, nga kirangirira nti emikono gyange n’omuntu wange bijja kuzikirizibwa.
Munnange yeegatta ku kampeyini yange ey’obulabe, ng’akuŋŋaanya amaggwa okubuna mu kkubo ly’oyo eyakowoola Allah.
Ku lunaku olw’omusango, ndisuulibwa mu muliro ogw’ennimi z’omuliro eziyaka, era munnange ajja kuba n’omuguwa ogw’enkindu mu bulago.
Nmanyiddwa erinnya eritegeeza ‘taata w’ennimi z’omuliro’ — erinnya eritegeeza ekifo kyange eky’olubeerera.
